entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Broken#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:EnemyFaction:SeparatistRegiments#0
entry.value: We always have a gift for traitors—132mm of the Emperor's fury.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:EnemyFaction:Orks#0
entry.value: Ah, Greenskins. What this cannon was built for.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:EnemyUnit:Neutral/Enslaver#0
entry.value: What are those THINGS? Keep them at range, men.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Hurt#0
entry.value: Crew compartment penetrated… it's a mess in here.

entry.value: Did you hear about the Saint of Basilisks? He got canonized. Geddit?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Idle#1
entry.value: Don't send a Manticore to do a Basilisk's job.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Idle#2
entry.value: I pity the poor grunts on the frontlines… but not enough to join 'em.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Idle#3
entry.value: Just tell us when there's something to shoot.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Idle#4
entry.value: Nothing happens in war… and it happens repeatedly.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Shaken#0
entry.value: Is someone actually shooting… at us?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:Victory#0
entry.value: Turning enemies into craters for ten millenium, sah!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Basilisk:WireWeed#0
entry.value: Biowire? I mean there are worse firing positions, like inside the Great Rift…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:AlliedFaction:SpaceMarines#0
entry.value: Marines bossman!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:AlliedUnit:SeparatistRegiments/Commissar#0
entry.value: Bullgryns loyal.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Artefact#0
entry.value: Big fing?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Attack#0
entry.value: Bullgryns fighting, yer bossman.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Broken#0
entry.value: Ogryns not that tough.

entry.value: Hiding inna bush.

entry.value: Wait, oos fighting fer the Emperor? Us or dem?

entry.value: Can't chew tin. Damn.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:EnemyFaction:Orks#0
entry.value: Orks. Tough, good lookin, clevver. Like us.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:EnemyFaction:SpaceMarines#0
entry.value: Da Emperor's kids? We goota fight dem?!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:EnemyUnit:Neutral/Enslaver#0
entry.value: Nah, I don't get what dey are.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Idle#0
entry.value: Dem Bone'eads… deys smart.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Idle#1
entry.value: One Ogryn on dead Ork's chest. Uh… two! Two Ogryns…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Idle#2
entry.value: Sharpening our clubs, sir.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Idle#3
entry.value: We do what's we's told. And you told us nuffin.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Shaken#0
entry.value: Wait… which way we goin?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:Victory#0
entry.value: What? Did we win?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Bullgryn:WireWeed#0
entry.value: Ow, me leg!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:AlliedFaction:SpaceMarines#0
entry.value: Praise the Emperor, the Astartes are here!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:AlliedUnit:SeparatistRegiments/Commissar#0
entry.value: Chests out, bellies in lads, it's the Lord Commissar.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Artefact#0
entry.value: Was that made by… Xenos?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Attack#0
entry.value: Can anyone see what we're shooting at?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Attack#1
entry.value: Enemies in front, commissar at our back…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Attack#2
entry.value: Give it everything you've got!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Attack#3
entry.value: I wish Creed was here…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Attack#4
entry.value: Pour on the las-fire, we might just make it.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Broken#0
entry.value: I didn't sign up for this!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Broken#1
entry.value: Run lads, and hope the Commissar ain't watching!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Broken#2
entry.value: They're killing us! And we can't kill them back!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Broken#3
entry.value: This is a bloody Death World!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Broken#4
entry.value: Where are the reinforcements? Where are-!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Cover#0
entry.value: Back in the trenches, thank the Emperor.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:EnemyUnit:Neutral/Enslaver#0
entry.value: Enslavers? Oh, Emperor preserve us.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:EnemyUnit:Neutral/Psychneuein#0
entry.value: Big bugs from Prospero—keep them away from the psykers!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:EnemyUnitNeutral/KhorneLordOfSkulls#0
entry.value: Chaos! Here?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Hurt#0
entry.value: We're done for, sir.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#0
entry.value: By the Golden Throne…!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#1
entry.value: For Guilliman and the Emperor!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#2
entry.value: How high, sir?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#3
entry.value: It's the silence before the battle that's the worst.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#4
entry.value: Just playing games, sir, Commissar says it's good for morale.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#5
entry.value: Life in the guard, sir. Terribly hard.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#6
entry.value: Receiving you loud and clear, sir!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#7
entry.value: Sir, yes, sir!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Idle#8
entry.value: Watch out, the Commissar's coming!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory0#0
entry.value: I still can't believe we survived. So many…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory1#0
entry.value: Getting the gang back together, sir.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory2#0
entry.value: A new city? Are we sure—no, sir, not questioning your orders, sir!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory3#0
entry.value: Those storms make my head hurt—will we be trapped here forever?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory4#0
entry.value: They're inside the city! Get back!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:QuestStory5#0
entry.value: My mum always said, 'never trust a tech-priest'. She was alright, my mum.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Shaken#0
entry.value: Can we pray? Oh, Emperor, oh Guilliman, preserve us.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Shaken#1
entry.value: Commander, we're falling back.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Shaken#2
entry.value: Courage, lads, courage.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Shaken#3
entry.value: If we stay, the enemy will shoot us. If we run, the Commissar will shoot us!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Shaken#4
entry.value: Can we get better guns, please?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Victory#0
entry.value: Commissar, sir, permission to celebrate?

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Victory#1
entry.value: Ha! I feel like we took down a Titan with a lightstick.

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Victory#2
entry.value: To the memory of Cadia and to Creed…

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Victory#3
entry.value: We're winning..? We're winning!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:Victory#4
entry.value: Wow, the Primer is right! These xenos are easy!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Guardsman:WireWeed#0
entry.value: Sir, the wire, it's alive!

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/LemanRussBattleTank:EnemyFaction:Necrons#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Commissar:AlliedUnit:SeparatistRegiments/Commissar#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Commissar:Cover#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Commissar:EnemyFaction:Orks#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Commissar:EnemyFaction:SpaceMarines#0

entry.name: SeparatistRegiments/Commissar:Hurt#0

entry.value: Dispensing justice is so tiring.
